To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel evolutionary clustering method for discovering a variable number of evolving, forming, or dissolving communities in dynamic networks, and that our method improves both the clustering accuracy and time performance by an orders of magnitude.

we propose a novel particle-and-density based method for discovering a variable number of evolutionary communities of arbitrary forming/dissolving in a dynamic network, and demonstrate that our method significantly improves the clustering accuracy and time performance compared with the current methods.
the particle-and-density based method is an effective and efficient method for evolutionary clustering of dynamic networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following three issues: (i) a novel evolutionary clustering method that can find a variable number communities of arbitrary forming or dissolving in a given dynamic networks; (ii) a novel particle-based evolutionary clustering method that is based on a collection of nano-communities and a quasi l-KK; and (iii) an efficient density-based evolutionary clustering method for finding smoothed local clusters of a high quality.

a novel particle-and-density based clustering method that can efficiently and accurately discover the variable number of communities with arbitrary forming and dissoling.

we have developed the first evolutionary clustering method for a variable number of arbitrary forming/dissolving communities in a dynamic network, and the method is efficient enough to be applied to large scale real data sets.

the particle-and-density based clustering method is very effective in discovering a variable number of evolutionary communities in a dynamic network, and the proposed mapping method is very useful in identifying the stage of each evolutionary community.
